text: Write the tokenizer's number rule, using maximal munch. Fill in the three blanks.
choices: while (j < src.length() && ___) j++;   // take as much as qualifies
explanation: Verified: `NUMBER 123`, `SYMBOL +`, `NUMBER 45`. The inner loop is maximal munch — take the longest run that could be a token — and it is why `123` is one number rather than three. Note that `i = j` rather than `i++` after emitting: forgetting that is an infinite loop, and it is the single most common bug when writing a scanner by hand.
